setting.name: jats_editor_enabled
setting.description: Expose the JATS editor API for this journal.

setting.name: api_token_hash
setting.description: SHA-256 hash of the per-journal API token. Managed from the plugin page.

setting.name: api_account_id
setting.description: Janeway account that owns files written through the editor API.

setting.name: editor_base_url
setting.description: Base URL of the pubReady editor, e.g. https://editor.example.org

setting.name: max_upload_mb
setting.description: Requests carrying a larger document or image are rejected.
